name: Likwid MarginPosition leverage-0 borrow reuses an unbooked AMM quote
summary: LikwidMarginPosition's leverage-0 borrow capped each loan at the pool's quote for selling the pledged collateral but never booked that sale, so every new position got the same quote. Attackers bought pool tokens from the vault, pledged them across 16 to 40 fresh positions in one transaction and walked away with more BNB than they paid.
notes: Immutable LikwidMarginPosition; its margin levels are constructor constants and the only MarginLevelChanged event comes after the campaign.

Each loss row is one cycle's net BNB depletion of LikwidVault: the borrow's BNB less the attacker's own BNB that bought the pledged tokens from the same vault (a round trip, rule 11), plus leftover tokens sold back (refs). Pump attempts that left the vault ahead are excluded; later liquidations are not netted.
The anchor is the first multi-position borrow: a scan of position mints since deployment finds no earlier transaction minting four or more positions.
